arXiv:2609.26544v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Simulating strongly correlated fermions remains a long-standing challenge due to the exponential complexity of the Hilbert space and the intricate sign structure of many-body wavefunctions. item.description:

👤 Shuai A. Chen, Roderich Moessner
arXiv:2609.26632v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Landau Fermi-liquid theory characterizes interacting metals through quasiparticles and their residual interactions. It is a challenge to incorporate non-trivial quantum geometry -- as encoded by Berry phases and the quantum metric -- as a fundamental ingredient.
